title: nelumbo nucifera var. lutea
intro: Nelumbo nucifera var. lutea, commonly known as the yellow lotus, is a variant of the Nelumbo nucifera plant, belonging to the family Nymphaeaceae. It is a perennial aquatic plant native to East Asia, valued for its medicinal properties and aesthetic appeal. The yellow lotus is rich in health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of the yellow lotus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
